prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mitoloka illustration of Hua Po, the palm-sized jade-white hairless woman tree spirit of Chinese lore, reviving under water.
ANATOMY: one woman's head, two eyes, two arms and two legs; completely hairless smooth pale white skin like white jade, grief clearly in eyes and brows; palm-sized, wearing a fully opaque simple ivory wrap robe [hua-po-c03,hua-po-c06]. No wings, horns, pointed ears or claws.
MOMENT: rise with one hand braced on rough bark and reach upward as a single enormous droplet of ordinary water breaks across her head and shoulders; head tilted toward viewer, intense sorrowful awake gaze.
POWER: she is revived by water, shown by her now-upright body amid a physical splash; no magical energy or glow [hua-po-c05,hua-po-c08].
SCALE & CAMERA: extreme macro low angle at bark surface, spirit fills most of square; the ordinary adult human fingertip dripping water above is several times her head size, clearly establishes palm-sized body.
LIGHT & WEATHER: one low warm side light, deep walnut tree hollow shadows, physical wet droplets only.
SURFACE: matte white jade-like skin, coarse opaque cloth, ancient textured bark, real clear water.
SETTING: in the tree on Zhanggong Mountain where Xie found and later returned her [hua-po-c06,hua-po-c09].
MOOD: solemn uncanny spirit, awe and grief, never evil or cute; powerful visual presence through macro framing.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: no hanged people, no hanging ropes; no text, logo, border or watermark; no extra heads/limbs/fingers; no entertainment design imitation; no nudity/gore; no generic glow aura/neon/energy ribbons.

visual_requirements.description: Hairless perempuan putih seperti jade berukuran telapak tangan, sorrowful brows.
Air memulihkan tubuh Hua Po; splash fisik, tanpa aura.
